pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Slider and Multi-Thumb Slider: each thumb is role=slider with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuetext.

aria.value: the label, plus 'Minimum' or 'Maximum' for range thumbs
bounds; range thumbs are limited by the other thumb
the value and its formatted text
true when disabled (also removed from the tab order)

keyboard.action: Increase by one step (ArrowLeft increases in right-to-left).
Decrease by one step (ArrowRight decreases in right-to-left).
Increase or decrease by the large step.
Set to the minimum or maximum (within the other thumb's limit for range).

focus: Each thumb is in the tab sequence; pressing the track focuses the moved thumb.
notes: Dragging has a single-pointer alternative (press on the track) and a keyboard alternative (WCAG 2.5.7).
Value text uses valueText or the number format, so screen readers hear '€20', '3 stars', or '09:00' rather than raw numbers.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
